parameters.name: apiBaseUrl
parameters.helpText: Base URL of the review API (src/review/server.js). Must be reachable from the agent's browser.

parameters.name: uc06ApiBaseUrl
parameters.helpText: Optional. Base URL of the UC-06 dual-approval API (src/uc06/server.js). Leave blank to disable UC-06 amendments in this sidebar.

parameters.name: cxSharedSecret
parameters.helpText: Optional. The HS256 shared secret this app signs its requests with — reads as well as approve/decline (ZAF's client.request jwt block). Set the SAME value as ZAF_SHARED_SECRET on the API. Leave blank for a local demo — the sidebar then falls back to unsigned requests, which a deployed API refuses.

parameters.name: signWrites
parameters.helpText: Tick this AFTER saving the shared secret above. A secure setting is never sent to the browser, so the app cannot detect on its own that the secret exists — this box is how it is told. It signs every request, reads included, because a deployed API requires a signed identity to read a case as well as to approve one. Leave unticked for a local demo with no secret set.
